import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); expected=json.loads(Path('/home/forclaw/tmp/implement-spec-104/segment-mapping.json').read_text())['segments']
ids=sys.argv[2:] or ['FH05']
for id in ids:
 s=next(x for x in expected if x['card']==id)
 c=json.loads((root/'cards'/f'{id}.json').read_text())
 assert c['segmentId']==s['segmentId'] and c['text']==s['text']
 assert all(c[k] for k in ['依据','关键画面','动作顺序','标注','关联素材'])
 print(id,'已确认文案、稳定身份与制作卡完整')

from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);ids=sys.argv[2:] or [f'FH{i:02}' for i in range(5,10)]; report=[]
for id in ids:
 c=json.loads((r/'cards'/f'{id}.json').read_text());frames=c['durationInFrames'];duration=frames/30
 for suffix in ['assembly.mp4','review.mp4','review.webm']:
  p=r/'outputs'/f'{id}-{suffix}';x=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]));v=next(s for s in x['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='video');aud=[s for s in x['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='audio'];decode=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True)
  assert decode.returncode==0 and decode.stderr==b'',f'{p}:解码stderr应为空'
  assert v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1';assert (v['width'],v['height'])==((960,540) if suffix.endswith('webm') else (1920,1080))
  assert bool(aud)==('review' in suffix);assert abs(float(x['format']['duration'])-duration)<.08
  if aud: assert float(x['format']['duration'])>=c['audioDuration']
  report.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(r)),'probe':x,'decodeReturncode':decode.returncode,'decodeStderr':decode.stderr.decode(),'card':id})
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,sys,array,math
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);records=[]
def decode(p):
 a=array.array('f');a.frombytes(subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-ac','1','-ar','24000','-f','f32le','-']));return a
for n in range(5,10):
 id=f'FH{n:02}';c=json.loads((r/'cards'/f'{id}.json').read_text());audio=r/c['audio'];src=Path('/home/forclaw/code/ClapGrid/clapgrid/media')/(c['taskId']+'.mp3');assert hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256(audio.read_bytes()).digest();a=decode(audio);b=decode(r/'outputs'/f'{id}-review.mp4');assert len(b)>=len(a);n=len(a);am=sum(a)/n;bm=sum(b[:n])/n;correlation=sum((x-am)*(y-bm) for x,y in zip(a,b))/math.sqrt(sum((x-am)**2 for x in a)*sum((y-bm)**2 for y in b[:n]));assert correlation>.97,(id,correlation);records.append({'id':id,'sourceTaskId':c['taskId'],'rawMp3Sha256':hashlib.sha256(audio.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'archiveCopyMatchesActualMp3':True,'decodedOriginalSamples24k':len(a),'decodedReviewSamples24k':len(b),'alignedFullAudioCorrelation':correlation,'completeOriginalSpanRetained':True,'limitation':'相关性验证是完整原速音轨技术证据，不是发音人工听审或逐字ASR'} )
print(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
r=Path('docs/productions/issue-104');files=[r/'outputs'/f'FH{i:02}-review.mp4' for i in range(5,10)]
cmd=['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error']
for p in files:cmd+=['-i',str(p)]
cmd+=['-filter_complex',''.join(f'[{i}:v:0][{i}:a:0]' for i in range(5))+'concat=n=5:v=1:a=1[v][a]','-map','[v]','-map','[a]','-c:v','libx264','-preset','fast','-crf','20','-r','30','-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-movflags','+faststart',str(r/'outputs/group107-review.mp4')];subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-i',str(r/'outputs/group107-review.mp4'),'-vf','scale=960:540','-c:v','libvpx','-b:v','1200k','-c:a','libvorbis',str(r/'outputs/group107-review.webm')],check=True)
report=[]
for name in ['group107-review.mp4','group107-review.webm']:
 p=r/'outputs'/name;x=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]));v=next(s for s in x['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='video');assert v['r_frame_rate']=='30/1';assert float(x['format']['duration'])>=sum(json.loads((r/'cards'/f'FH{i:02}.json').read_text())['audioDuration'] for i in range(5,10));d=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-f','null','-'],capture_output=True);assert d.returncode==0 and d.stderr==b'';report.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(r)),'probe':x,'decodeReturncode':d.returncode,'decodeStderr':d.stderr.decode()})
(r/'evidence/107-continuous-media-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,hashlib,datetime,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);a=Path('/home/forclaw/tmp/implement-spec-104/archives/group107-v1');a.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for directory in ['src','cards','outputs','public','references','evidence']:
 (a/directory).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
files=['src/shared.tsx','src/anatomy.tsx','src/group107.tsx','entry107.tsx','render.mjs','package.json','package-lock.json','tsconfig.json','segment-mapping.json','verify-media.py','review107.html','public/fonts/noto-cjk-sc.otf','public/fonts/OFL-and-source.txt']
files += [str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in (r/'cards').glob('FH0[5-9].json')]
files += [str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in (r/'outputs').glob('*') if any(p.name.startswith(i) for i in ['FH05-','FH06-','FH07-','FH08-','FH09-','group107-'])]
files += [str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in (r/'public/audio').glob('FH0[5-9].mp3')]
files += [str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in (r/'references').glob('107-*')]
files += [str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in (r/'evidence').glob('107-*') if p.name not in ['107-archive-manifest.json','107-source-archive-correspondence.json']]
for name in files:
 dst=a/name;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(r/name,dst)
shutil.copy2('/home/forclaw/tmp/implement-spec-104/archives/fh10-v1/dependency-resources-linux-x64.tgz',a/'dependency-resources-linux-x64.tgz')
# 字体实际保存在public/fonts中，依赖以锁定版本资源包保存，恢复时须解包。
segments=[]
for n in range(5,10):
 c=json.loads((r/'cards'/f'FH{n:02}.json').read_text());sd=a/'segments'/c['segmentId'];sd.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(sd/'narration.txt').write_text(c['text']+'\n');(sd/'card.json').write_text(json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');segments.append({'id':c['id'],'segmentId':c['segmentId'],'order':c['order'],'text':c['text'],'voice':c['voice'],'taskId':c['taskId'],'audio':c['audio'],'durationInFrames':c['durationInFrames'],'audioDuration':c['audioDuration'],'card':f"cards/{c['id']}.json",'assembly':c['关联素材']['assembly'],'review':c['关联素材']['review']})
(a/'review.md').write_text('''# FH05–FH09 · group107-v1\n\n改了什么：已确认静态视觉规则重绘为可编辑SVG动画，实际有效配音原速完整保留；输出本组连续预览、各段无旁白无烧录旁白字幕装配素材。\n\n之前确认过什么：#96 v0.2文案、#97温暖分层与机制规则、#99现有配音流程、#101归档设计。旧静态稿与本次新动画不同，本次画面不自动继承旧稿确认。\n\n这次需要看什么：新画面、字幕可读性、五段衔接、局部修复动作节奏与实际发音。画面确认和人工听审待用户；全片终审由后续完整版本承担。\n\n复现：解开dependency-resources-linux-x64.tgz；npm run typecheck；node render.mjs --card cards/FH09.json --entry entry107.tsx --out restored-output。所有字体、原声、参考及来源清单实际保存在本目录，不依赖项目临时媒体URL。正式MP4为1920×1080/30fps，审阅WebM为960×540。恢复核对以清单哈希、输入身份、媒体探测和实际重新渲染为准，不能仅以找到MP3判断项目有效配音恢复。\n''')
manifest={'version':'group107-v1','previousVersion':None,'change':'首次按#104制作FH05–FH09；继承#97确认规则，不扩大确认范围','createdAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline':'122a787d7ce02e008404833e920d4e1f8c17682e','segments':segments,'production':{'width':1920,'height':1080,'fps':30,'entry':'entry107.tsx','fixedTextureSeed':17,'voiceUnmodified':True,'assemblySilent':True,'assemblyNarrationSubtitles':False},'confirmed':{'narration':'https://github.com/dulltackle/ClapGrid/issues/96#issuecomment-6108628717','visualRules':'https://github.com/dulltackle/ClapGrid/issues/97#issuecomment-6110063575','archiveDesign':'https://github.com/dulltackle/ClapGrid/issues/101#issuecomment-6117735738'},'pending':['本次新动画画面用户确认','人工发音听审','全片终审'],'resources':{'dependencies':'dependency-resources-linux-x64.tgz','fonts':'public/fonts','sourceIdentity':'fileChecksums'},'fileChecksums':[]}
for p in sorted(a.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and p.name!='manifest.json':manifest['fileChecksums'].append({'path':str(p.relative_to(a)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size})
(a/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(str(a))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);m=json.loads((r/'manifest.json').read_text())
for f in m['fileChecksums']:
 p=r/f['path'];assert p.is_file();assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],str(p)
for s in m['segments']:
 c=json.loads((r/s['card']).read_text());assert c['segmentId']==s['segmentId'] and c['text']==s['text'] and c['voice']==s['voice'] and c['taskId']==s['taskId'];assert (r/'segments'/s['segmentId']/'narration.txt').read_text().strip()==c['text'];assert (r/s['audio']).is_file()
print(json.dumps({'archive':str(r),'version':m['version'],'checksumCount':len(m['fileChecksums']),'inputIdentityMatch':True,'result':'passed'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
